blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines ranked 79th in the 2026 Legatum Prosperity Index, which measures national prosperity across three domains — development, freedom and society. The Philippines had an overall score of 63.06, higher than but still close to the global median of 62.48. Each of the 161 countries in the index received a score derived from assessments of development, freedom and social well-being, a structure new to this year’s edition.
